In return for your contribution, you'll receive a starting gross monthly salary of € 3.182,-, including shift allowance. From day one, you can also enjoy an attractive package of secondary benefits, such as on-site sports facilities and lunch or dinner in a modern company restaurant. The company is conveniently located along the A50, making it easy to reach! 
Your day starts with a short team check-in, after which you'll start assembling products together with your buddy: - Assemble components such as cables, parts, modules, and cabinets - Follow clear work instructions and basic technical drawings - Perform simple quality checks and visual inspections - Start with small assembly tasks - Grow towards more complex builds - Work in a clean, structured environment within a team of around 30 colleagues
